snippet.title: Eden Genesis — A Cyberpunk Adventure | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Eden Genesis is a platform game focused on fast-paced trials, quick reflexes, and a rich story by the same dev team responsible for Aeterna Noctis and Summum Aeterna. Take control of Leah, a young cyborg lady, and overcome challenging trials to liberate her corrupted mind!
